answer: Room echo liveness checks. Each identity enrolls a room by playing an unpredictable whisper and recording its reverberation tail; at random times it answers a nonce with fresh audio. The verifier checks decay and timing against that fingerprint. A single operator cannot fake several distinct rooms at once because tails depend on geometry and materials such as velvet drapes. Faking one identity costs separate room access, a speaker/mic pair, copper wiring, and upkeep.
